diagnosis: The customer is on a startup plan which does not include SSO. According to the feature matrix, SSO is only available on standard and premium tiers. They will need to upgrade their plan to obtain this feature.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. SSO is not included in the startup plan you are currently on; it is available on our standard and premium tiers. If you would like to enable SSO, you can upgrade to one of those plans. Please let us know if you’d like more information about the upgrade options.
